votes.motion: Approve the Fire Chief employment contract (voted at the prior meeting in Executive Session); described as a unanimous vote to support.

votes.motion: Appoint Todd Blake to the School Committee vacancy, by roll call vote.
votes.quote: mr. matthews called for a roll call vote to appoint mr. todd blake to the school committee.

votes.motion: Start the process toward a Town Meeting for the EPG Solar net metering project, commit to going to Town Meeting, without committing to any agreements yet.
votes.quote: mr. debettencourt moved the vote. mr. sund seconded. on vote, motion carried, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

decisions.decision: Ms. Speidel will ask the Assessors office to provide an updated estimated Assessed Valuation Calculation for the EPG Solar project.

decisions.decision: Town Counsel's review of the MSBA Contract/Feasibility Study is not complete; a draft will be sent to the BOS and the item placed on next week's agenda.
